summary: Layer 1B expansion found that the strongest underfollowed mapping is not another hyperscaler or utility, but companies tied to medium-voltage electrical distribution, switchgear, data-center electrical installation, engineering/TICC, and AI-ready rack/power/cooling integration. Reference leaders remain Vertiv, Eaton, GE Vernova, Quanta Services, NextEra, and Constellation. New candidates below are focused on less obvious public-market links: Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and behind-the-meter data-center orders; IES Holdings for electrical/technology systems and data-center backlog; TIC Solutions/Acuren-NV5 for hyperscaler design, inspection, certification, and asset-intelligence services; and nVent as a higher-attention but still narrower electrical connection/protection and AI cooling/power integration reference.
